rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Desktop customer login is implemented as a modal (CustomerLoginModal) triggered from Navbar, not as a dedicated /login page. The wishlist feature components (WishlistHeartButton, CustomerWishlistsPage, CustomerWishlistDetailPage) all redirect to /login which doesn't exist in App.js routes.
